verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Bolna publishes an llms.txt at docs.bolna.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes the docs as markdown pages, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. The llms.txt also declares an OpenAPI spec section, but that spec returns 404, which weakens the agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: a working machine-readable OpenAPI spec linked from llms.txt, first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or agent-docs offering (e.g. llms-full.txt), and independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.bolna.ai/llms.txt # Bolna Docs
the Bolna docs llms.txt declares "## OpenAPI Specs" pointing at /docs/api-reference/openapi.yml
